svg.title: .nxc
svg.desc: .nxc: colour-clash-free Spectrum games for the ZX Spectrum Next, from your own copy of the game. Your game plus the patch, which holds no game data, becomes the game with its clash fixed, on your Next.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: PATCHES FOR THE ZX SPECTRUM NEXT

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
